description: This file contains utility functions for UI testing and automation in an Android application, specifically related to permissions and UI element interactions during benchmarking.

methods.name: allowNotifications
methods.description: Grants the POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission on devices running Android Tiramisu (API >= TIRAMISU).

methods.name: startActivityAndAllowNotifications
methods.description: Starts the app activity and grants notification permission.

methods.name: getTopAppBar
methods.description: Waits for and returns the UI object representing the top app bar identified by the resource ID 'niaTopAppBar'.

methods.name: waitForObjectOnTopAppBar
methods.description: Waits until a specific UI object appears on the top app bar, given a UI selector.
